contracts.description: swe/pr-reviewer agent_runs completed in the last 7 days and not marked unmeasured carry tokens
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_runs
             WHERE agent_type IN ('swe','pr-reviewer') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', completed_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND (usage_source IS NULL OR usage_source <> 'unmeasured')
               AND COALESCE(tokens_in, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(tokens_out, 0) = 0
               AND COALESCE(cache_read_tokens, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(cache_creation_tokens, 0) = 0
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT id, task_id, agent_type, usage_source, completed_at FROM agent_runs
             WHERE agent_type IN ('swe','pr-reviewer') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', completed_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days')
               AND (usage_source IS NULL OR usage_source <> 'unmeasured')
               AND COALESCE(tokens_in, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(tokens_out, 0) = 0
               AND COALESCE(cache_read_tokens, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(cache_creation_tokens, 0) = 0
             ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: tasks closed in the last 30 days and more than TMB_REVIEW_GRACE_HOURS (default 24) ago have a passing pr-reviewer verdict or a review_gate_bypassed/review_gate_waived row (bro_atomic_close closes before pr-reviewer runs; tasks has no closed_at, so the close time is updated_at)
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t
             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now', '-' || :grace_hours || ' hours')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts v WHERE v.task_id = t.id AND v.verdict = 'pass')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit a WHERE a.event_type IN ('review_gate_bypassed','review_gate_waived')
                                AND CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id)
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT t.id, t.issue_id, t.branch_id, t.updated_at FROM tasks t
             WHERE t.status = 'closed' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-30 days')
               AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now', '-' || :grace_hours || ' hours')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts v WHERE v.task_id = t.id AND v.verdict = 'pass')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit a WHERE a.event_type IN ('review_gate_bypassed','review_gate_waived')
                                AND CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END = t.id)
             ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no running task has gone TMB_STALE_RUNNING_HOURS (default 6) without an update and without an open swe agent_runs row
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t
             WHERE t.status = 'running' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now', '-' || :stale_hours || ' hours')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.agent_type = 'swe' AND r.completed_at IS NULL)
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT t.id, t.issue_id, t.updated_at FROM tasks t
             WHERE t.status = 'running' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t.updated_at) < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now', '-' || :stale_hours || ' hours')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.agent_type = 'swe' AND r.completed_at IS NULL)
             ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 5

contracts.description: some repo was scanned in the last 7 days (1 when fresh; passes with no repo row)
contracts.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 WHEN MAX(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', last_scanned_at)) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM repos

contracts.description: no (task_id, commit_sha) carries more than one verification_gate_waived row
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM audit a WHERE a.event_type = 'verification_gate_waived'
             GROUP BY CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END, COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.commit_sha') END, '') HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END AS task_id, CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.commit_sha') END AS commit_sha, COUNT(*) AS n FROM audit a
             WHERE a.event_type = 'verification_gate_waived'
             GROUP BY CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.task_id') END, COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(a.content_json) THEN json_extract(a.content_json, '$.commit_sha') END, '') HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no embeddings_degraded audit row from the last 24 hours lacks a later embeddings_recovered row (semantic search is falling back to FTS)
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit d
             WHERE d.event_type = 'embeddings_degraded' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', d.created_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-1 days')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit r WHERE r.event_type = 'embeddings_recovered' AND r.id > d.id)
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT d.id, d.created_at, d.content_json FROM audit d
             WHERE d.event_type = 'embeddings_degraded' AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', d.created_at) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-1 days')
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit r WHERE r.event_type = 'embeddings_recovered' AND r.id > d.id)
             ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 5

contracts.description: no closed issue still has a pending/running/needs_validation/completed task
contracts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FROM issues i JOIN tasks t ON t.issue_id = i.id
             WHERE i.status = 'closed' AND t.status IN ('pending','running','needs_validation','completed')
contracts.sample_sql:
SELECT i.id AS issue_id, t.id AS task_id, t.status FROM issues i JOIN tasks t ON t.issue_id = i.id
             WHERE i.status = 'closed' AND t.status IN ('pending','running','needs_validation','completed') ORDER BY i.id DESC, t.id LIMIT 5
